venue: IBKR own account, British Columbia resident (Interactive Brokers Canada Inc.)
fee_rule: all_in_usd_per_side = IBKR execution (USD 0.85, the <=1,000 contracts/month band, equal for Tiered and Fixed) + clearing (USD 0.00 per the worked examples) + exchange fee (non-member / Tier I, exchange page of the product) + regulatory fee (exchange page).
